paper_title: $M^3EL$ A Multi-task Multi-topic Dataset for Multi-modal Entity Linking
caption: : Entity topic distribution.
model_annotation: The donut chart illustrates the distribution of entity topics within the $M^3EL$ dataset, with each segment representing a distinct topic and its corresponding proportion. The chart is divided into five categories: Moive, Common, Person, Book, and Sport, each color-coded and labeled in the legend. The largest segment, colored light blue, corresponds to the "Moive" topic, accounting for 41.2% of the total. The "Person" topic, shown in light pink, makes up 30.5% of the distribution. The "Common" topic, in light green, represents 14.9%. The "Book" topic, in light yellow, accounts for 9.1%, and the "Sport" topic, in light purple, constitutes the smallest portion at 4.3%. The percentages are clearly labeled within each slice of the chart, and the visual layout shows the segments arranged in a clockwise order, with the largest slice positioned at the top and the smallest at the bottom right.
